recomputed:
All 31 SOURCES.tsv entries matched their SHA-256 and byte length. I parsed the JSON, XML, SOFT and tabular responses, opened both PDFs and workbooks, and read every compressed matrix through its gzip trailer. Three TXT files contain accession-specific HTML deletion notices. europe-supp-status.xml contains a service error and elsevier.xml contains bibliographic metadata. The 162,099,200-byte count archive matches the historical receipt. The 3,986-byte family SOFT differs from the historical 3,964-byte receipt and links GSE289461 to PMID 40112816.

The independent recount used all eight matrices. In GSM8791791–GSM8791798 order, barcode counts were 22,497, 27,429, 37,166, 21,482, 21,061, 12,684, 36,001 and 30,391. Counts passing >500 positive gene rows and <5% mitochondrial UMIs were 4,841, 1,961, 4,292, 7,363, 2,702, 6,457, 4,057 and 4,669. The mitochondrial numerator used all case-insensitive mt- symbols and the denominator used all UMIs per barcode. Barcode counts, gene-row counts, nonzero entries and total UMIs matched the registered per-GSM QC. Control and knockout totals were 108,574 and 100,137 deposited, and 18,457 and 17,885 after the two cutoffs. The manuscript and published Results give 9,111 and 9,909 classified cells. The differences were 9,346 and 7,976, or 17,322 overall (36,342 versus 19,020). The count difference does not identify which cells the authors used or why the totals differ.

The registered DE table and sample sheet matched producer hashes. The fitted groupcase coefficient compares Mettl14 knockout with control using four GSM pseudobulks per arm. The edgeR-QL design contains an intercept and genotype. The table contains 17,515 distinct published symbols and 157 local FDR < 0.05 calls. Provenance gives 17,517 tested rows including two unpublished rows. Table S1 contains 90 negative and 136 positive gene-by-cluster effects across nine non-neuronal clusters on each gene sheet. These represent 50 and 128 distinct labels, respectively. Adjusted P is ≥0.05 on 17 down and 9 up rows. The remaining two sheets report GO terms. Table S2 contains reagents. Figure S2F plots knockout versus control in three neuronal clusters. None of these supplies paired gene effects for the registered tissue-wide contrast.

I checked the registry and all five ledgers. Manual and verification records exist. The other three ledgers contain no record for this dataset. All proposed enum and evidence-link values already occur in the ledgers. The corrected proposal passes check_proposals.cjs. The author-concordance-v2 requirements for compatible cohorts, contrasts and effects cannot be met with these sources. The recount used only the published cutoffs. No cluster or gene subset entered a concordance calculation. The unresolved outcome, empty sign-off and needs_author_contact closure are justified.
problems: The published accession is inconsistent within the article. The data statement on PDF page 14 gives GSE267200. The Key Resources Table on page 21 prints GSE26720, which resolves to an unrelated 2011 chromatin and DNA methylation study (PMID 21321082). The PMC manuscript gives GSE267200. Neither accession resolves the GSE289461 library mapping.

The proposal omitted two conflicting labels relevant to reconstructing the cohort. STAR Methods names M3NKO in the integration sentence, although the Results and Figure S2 specify M14NKO. GEO titles call GSM8791797 and GSM8791798 knockout replicates 3 and 4, respectively, while their DGE filenames contain NM14KO4 and NM14KO3. The evidence supports retaining the documented genotypes and requesting the authors’ sample key.

The statement about cluster-specific gene effects needs the P0 single-cell scope. The paper also reports expression in other preparations. Figure 3C shows expression of selected markers within neuronal clusters. Figure S2F shows three neuronal cluster comparisons. Table S1 lists positive and negative effects, including 26 rows with adjusted P ≥ 0.05, and provides no tissue-wide result. The registry also calls all 208,711 barcode columns cells, although the paper classified 19,020.

The manifest describes GSE267199.txt and GSE267202.txt as companion series records. Both contain HTML deletion notices, like the correctly labeled GSE267200.txt. They establish the deletion notices only.
